message.content: The sculpture most often cited as the iconic masterpiece of the 19th‑century art world is **“The Kiss” by Auguste Rodin** (1889).  While Rodin’s later work “The Thinker” (1902) has become a global symbol of sculpture, it was created just after the 19th century.  “The Kiss” captures the era’s fascination with realism, emotion, and the human form, and it remains one of the most reproduced and celebrated works from that period.
